summary: Recipe Library API tests - All 35 backend tests passed (100%). The recipe library feature successfully stores AI-generated recipes and provides browse, search, filter, and discovery capabilities. Recipes are correctly saved from both /api/chat/send and /api/diabetes/recipes endpoints.

minor.issue: Minor: 'dietary' field has inconsistent casing ('Vegetarian' vs 'vegetarian') due to variations in AI output - cosmetic only

passed_tests: GET /api/recipe-library/stats - Returns total_recipes, cuisines breakdown, dietary breakdown, most_popular
GET /api/recipe-library/browse - Returns recipes list with filters (cuisine, dietary, meal_type, mood)
POST /api/recipe-library/search - Full-text search by title and tags
POST /api/recipe-library/search - Minimum query length validation (400 for < 2 chars)
POST /api/recipe-library/search - Recipe structure validation (id, title, cuisine, dietary)
GET /api/recipe-library/discover - Cuisine and dietary filters work
GET /api/recipe-library/cuisines - Returns list of cuisines with counts
POST /api/chat/send - Generates recipes and saves to library (verified: count 15→19 after Japanese)
POST /api/diabetes/recipes - Generates diabetes recipes and saves to library (verified: count 19→22 after Thai)

times_served incremented on duplicate instead of creating new entry (deduplication working)
All endpoints exclude MongoDB _id field in responses
